GCN 20084: 15 GHz AMI-LA 3-sigma upper limit; source reports UT dates to 0.01 day precision (Oct 11.44/13.66/14.60/18.56). Half-step ±0.005 d = 432 s recorded as time_err; time and MJD are relative to the adjudicated Swift/BAT T0 for GRB161011A; the separate earlier Konus/AGILE event is not included.

GCN 20030 Table explicitly labels t−T0 (mid, days) and gives 0.32098 d; adopt the published midpoint 27732.672 s relative to canonical Swift/BAT T0=2016-10-11T05:54:54.1138Z. UT start is 2016-10-11 13:13:27, with 21×120 s exposures; adding half the summed exposure to the start would give 13:34:27 UT, about 159 s earlier than the published midpoint, and the circular gives no frame cadence to reconstruct the actual coadd midpoint. time_err=1260 s is half the reported summed exposure. Candidate is reported in the Swift GRB161011A XRT error circle (GCN 20026).

GCN 20041 reports RATIR observation window 2016-10-13.11 to 13.15 UTC, explicitly 44.66–45.69 h after the Swift/BAT trigger; use the more precise relative window midpoint 45.175 h (162630 s) and half-span 0.515 h (1854 s) per repository §3.8. The rounded absolute UT window midpoint (13.13) is 108 s later, within the time precision of the reported ranges. AB magnitudes, 3-sigma upper limits, not corrected for Galactic extinction; circular reports total exposures 0.69 h in r/i and 0.27 h in Z/Y/J/H. This follows canonical GRB161011A T0.
